Metadata.title: AKIBA — Clothes made in Kigali

errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a Rwandan mobile number, for example 078 123 4567.
errors.pinInvalid: Your PIN must be exactly 5 digits.
errors.pinWeak: Choose a PIN that is harder to guess, not 12345 or 11111.
errors.typesRequired: Choose at least one type of tailoring.
errors.experienceRequired: Choose how long you have been tailoring.
errors.locationRequired: Enter where buyers can find your shop.
errors.termsRequired: Please agree to the terms to continue.
errors.codeInvalid: Enter the 6-digit code from the SMS.

errors.phoneTaken: This number already has an account. Log in instead.
errors.wrongPin: That phone number and PIN don’t match.
errors.locked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {minutes} minutes, or reset your PIN.
errors.tooManyCodes: Please wait a minute before asking for another code.
errors.smsFailed: We couldn’t send the SMS. Check the number and try again.
errors.noAccount: There’s no AKIBA account with this number. Sign up instead.

Terms.title: Terms & conditions
Terms.placeholder: The full terms and privacy notice are added before the pilot. In short: you own the stories and photos you publish, you can remove them or close your account at any time, and AKIBA never shares your phone number except with a buyer who requests your garment.
